title: Macquarie Lighthouse

buildingCutout.basis: Named mapped rectangle for Barnet’s standing lighthouse and attached bays.

terrainReference.basis: Original sampled road-side grass approach beyond the west-facing footprint.

identities.name: Macquarie Lighthouse
identities.address: Old South Head Road, Vaucluse, New South Wales

mapIdentity.scope: Exact named building polygon, original coastal grade, and the State Library's explicit public-domain James Barnet elevation, plan and section, used after reviewing the published Qualla gallery.

note: Square masonry plinth rises to a round tower and projecting gallery. The late Victorian cast iron lantern has diamond-patterned glazing and a domed cap above. The two low attached rooms have leaded domes.
